capabilities: Scope notes by folder, tag and property conditions before editing
Merge or rename tags and property keys with a preview of affected notes
Bulk-add properties to many notes via a guided wizard
Normalize inconsistent date values into one format
Undo batch changes through a local history journal
extras: Free with voluntary donations (WeChat Pay/Alipay). Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.8.7+; mobile unsupported. Works fully offline with no telemetry. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Localized in Chinese and English.
motivation: The author built it because vaults fill up with near-duplicate tags, inconsistent property keys and dates written many ways, and the built-in property panel handles only one field at a time.
problem: Obsidian's built-in property panel only renames one field in one note at a time, so fixing years of accumulated duplicate tags, inconsistent property keys and messy date formats normally means scripting or a linter.
summary: Visual workbench that bulk-cleans properties and tags across selected notes: merge tags, rename keys, bulk-add fields, and normalize dates.
